events.verdict: Thompson (HOU) maintains verticality and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs following the release of Hield's (GSW) driving shot attempt.
Smith Jr. (HOU) is adjusting to Hield's (GSW) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together at the same spot during the driving shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Hield (GSW) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Although Hield makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it from Eason's (HOU) hands, he then follows-through on Eason's right arm with more than marginal contact as the ball becomes loose. The play is correctly deemed a loose ball foul and Eason is awarded two free throws for HOU being in the penalty.
VanVleet (HOU) brings his arm up through Kuminga's (GSW) right arm as the pass is thrown and contact occurs that affects Kuminga's ability to secure the ball.
Brooks (HOU) places his arm over Green's (GSW) left arm during the pick and the two briefly tangle arms before Green is able to move around the marginal contact.
Green (GSW) jumps from point A to point B and initiates contact with Thompson (HOU), which affects his driving shot attempt.

Kuminga (GSW) absorbs the marginal arm to arm contact that occurs with Eason (HOU) as Eason comes up through for his shot attempt near the basket. Any arm to arm contact that follows occurs as a result of Kuminga absorbing contact and is thus incidental.
Green (GSW) legally contests Smith Jr.'s (HOU) layup attempt.
Brooks (HOU) reaches for the ball and marginal arm to arm contact occurs with Hield (GSW) as the ball is dislodged OOB.
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence Brooks (HOU) is not the the last player to touch the ball before he dislodges it OOB.
Payton II (GSW) jumps from point A to point B and makes contact with VanVleet's (HOU) back, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Brooks (HOU) commits a take foul on Green (GSW) just after Green releases the pass.
Wiggins (GSW) and Smith Jr. (HOU) mutually engage and immediately disengage as marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Brooks (HOU) commits a take foul on Podziemski (GSW).
Holiday (HOU) keeps the loose ball in-bounds before securing it.
Green (GSW) makes contact with Eason's (HOU) right arm, which causes him to lose control of the ball.
VanVleet (HOU) moves alongside Hield's (GSW) path as they move up the court, the pair make incidental foot to foot contact with one another on the play.
